definition: to cross a river where it is shallow
description: In a bare mountain valley at sunset, an orange off-road truck drives slowly through a wide, shallow glacial river with water splashing around its wheels, and the driver leans out of the window. Beside it a line of young hikers with backpacks hold hands and wade across, the water up to their knees. Behind them a gravel track leads to a yellow tent, with a glacier, dark mountains and steam rising in the golden evening light. Coloured marker poles stand on the near bank.

de.answer: Sie durchqueren den Fluss Hand in Hand.

es.answer: Están vadeando el río de la mano.
